Commentary.Commentary: Stay tuned as the Aussie openers will be out soon to start the chase and will be interesting to see what approach they adapt.

Right then, Australia didn't take too long after tea to pick the remaining two wickets. They now need 86 to win this Test match and level the series. Once again it was Nathan Lyon who tamed the Bangla Tigers by picking up a 6-fer. He completely ran through their batting line-up and kept the hosts on the back foot. There was no fight shown by the top order yet again and some lower order contributions helped them take the lead beyond the 50-run mark.

OUT! IT'S ALL OVER! Floated outside off, Rahman lunges forward and tries to defend it with the spin. But it ain't there and the ball skids past the bat to hit the off pole. Steve O'Keefe gets another wicket to his name and BANGLADESH HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 157!
Flatter outside off, Rahman gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Fuller outside off, Hasan leans forward to defend it.
Mehedi camps back and punches it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Flatter outside off, Mehedi tries to cut but fails to make contact.
Quicker outside off, Hasan lunges forward in defence.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Floated around off, Hasan defends it neatly.
Tosses this one in line of the stumps, Mehedi goes for the sweep. Smith from first slip premeditates and rushes towards leg slip. Dives but fails to stop the ball. A single is taken.
Floated outside off, Hasan leaves it alone.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Quicker outside off, Hasan shoulders his arms to it.
Tossed up around off, Mehedi gets forward to defend it.
Floated around off, Hasan lunges forward to defend it.
Rahman gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Mustafizur Rahman is the last man in.

OUT! Cleaned up! Nathan Lyon fires a quicker delivery around the off stump line. Islam fails to get his bat down in time. Brushes his back pad and then the ball goes onto smash the timber. Lyon gets another one and Bangladesh lead by 84 runs. He set up the batsman beautifully. Got the previous couple of balls to spin away and then darts one in.
Tossed up outside off, Islam shoulders his arms to it.
Good take Steven! Tossed up around off, spins away and bounces a bit more than expected. The batsman is beaten and so is the keeper. Smith stretches to his right and stops the ball.
Drifting into the pads, Islam lunges forward in defence. Gets an inside edge onto his pads.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shorter outside off, Hasan shoulders his arms to it.
Tossed up around middle and leg, Mehedi gets forward and drives it uppishly towards the cover region.
Mehedi camps back and defends it neatly.
Fuller outside off, Mehedi leans forward and defends it.
Tossed up around off, Islam lunges forward and defends it.
Sprayed down the leg side, Taijul clips it fine past the keeper for a couple. First runs after Tea this.
Short outside off, Islam goes for the cut but fails to make contact.
Skidding away from around off, Islam prods forward in defence. Gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Floated up outside off, Islam lunges forward and defends it towards the fielder at silly point.
Again short outside off, cut towards the fielder at backward point.
Shorter outside off, Taijul Islam camps back and cuts it towards the fielder at backward point.
Hasan gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Tossed up outside off, Mehedi Hasan chooses to let it through to the keeper.
Fuller in line of the stumps, Mehedi defends it back to the bowler.
Flatter outside off, Hasan lets it through to the keeper.
Mehedi covers his stumps and stays back to defend it.
Tossed up outside off, Hasan stays in his crease and defends it.
Tossed up around off, defended towards the fielder at point.
Flatter outside off, Islam shoulders his arms to it.
Fuller on off, Islam lunges forward in defence.
Floats it around off, Islam gets forward and blocks it away.
Taijul gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Short outside off, Islam goes for the cut. Gets it on the bounce towards the fielder at slip.
Nathan Lyon to bowl from the other end.
Outside off, left alone.
Mehedi Hasan camps back and gets his defence in place.
Tossed up outside off, Mehedi shoulders his arms to it.
Fuller around off, defended neatly.
Around off, Hasan camps back and blocks it solidly.
Floated outside off, Mehedi Hasan shuffles across and defends it.
We are back for the final session. Mehedi Hasan to face Steve O'Keefe first up. A slip, a silly point and a short leg in place.
... Day 4, Session 3 ...

Another good session for Australia. They picked up further three wickets in the afternoon and have strengthened their grip on this Test match. Bangladesh's lower middle order fought hard and added some runs but the continuous fall of wickets kept them on the back foot. They lead by 82 runs at the moment with two wickets left. Anything over 100 will be challenging on this surface and the home side will be hopeful of achieving it. Do join us in a short while.
Good length ball on middle, Taijul defends it from the back foot to point. Tea on day 4!
Good length delivery around off, angling away, Taijul hangs his bat out but doesn't go at it. Lets it through to the keeper.
Islam has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A roaring short ball on middle, 141.9 kph, rising onto the batsman, Taijul does well to get on top of the bounce as he keeps it out safely.
Short in length and outside off, Taijul backs away a bit to make room and runs it down past gully for a couple of runs.
Full and around middle and off, Taijul covers the line and defends it back.
Pulls his length back and lands it outside off, Hasan remains inside the crease, waits for the ball to spin back in and then dead bats it down on the surface.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Lyon goes full this time, full and on middle, Mehedi helps it off his pads towards short mid-wicket.
Identical to the last delivery, Mehedi eases himself on the back foot in defense.
This one spins back into the batsman from outside off, Hasan does well to defend it near his front pad.
Edged but safe! Floated off spinner around off, Mehedi plays for the spin but it skids through to kiss the outside edge. It speeds past first slip and they collect a couple of runs.
Another length delivery outside off, Taijul plays from the back foot and pushes it towards covers.
Not a yorker but it's on a length and around middle, Islam keeps his weight on the back foot as he defends it safely.
Tries to unsettle Taijul with a well-directed bouncer, he ducks underneath it like a typical tailender. Smelling a yorker here.
Bowls it on a length and outside off, holding its line, Taijul shoulders arms.
Runs in from around the wicket and angles in a length ball on middle, Taijul defends it off his back foot. A short leg and leg gully are waiting for a false shot.
Short in length and outside off, Mehedi stands tall inside the crease and slams it over cover-point. There is protection in the deep and hence only a run.
Flighted and full on off, Taijul presses forward in defense. End of a successful over, a wicket maiden!
A round-arm action delivery, full and drifting on off, Taijul defends it back from the front foot.
Goes even quicker, 94.4 kph, around middle, Islam blocks it from the crease.
Fires it full and on off, 87.5 kph, Islam defends it back off his front foot.
Slower through the air, full and outside off, Taijul draws forward to defend but is beaten by the little away spin.
Taijul Islam is in next.

OUT! Superb catch in the deep by Pat Cummins! Third consecutive fifer, 12th overall for Nathan Lyon, he is on fire! Lets out a loopy full ball around leg, Haque sits down on one knee for the sweep shot but it takes the top edge and balloons in the air. Pat Cummins in the deep backward square leg region rushes across to his left and completes a superb catch with a tumble. Bangladesh lead by 77 runs.
Digs in a short ball around middle and leg, Mominul gets on top of the bounce and eases his pull shot to fine leg for a run. Well controlled shot by him.
Pitches it full and lands it outside off, Mominul strides forward and drives it to mid off. Looks for a run but then stops mid-way.
Point drops back.
Steams in from over the wicket and angles across a good length ball on off, Mominul stays back and hits it towards backward point.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Back of a length ball on middle and off, angling away, Hasan taps it down from the crease. It rolls towards cover-point where the fielder is caught napping. They steal a quick single. Should have stopped that run as Pat is working on a plan against Mehedi by bowling from around the wicket with a gully in place.
Cummins darts in a short ball around leg, Hasan ducks. The bowler fires in some verbal volleys and Mehedi just smiles.
Switches to over the wicket and dishes out an off spinner around middle. It spins away with some extra life, Mominul stands back and defends it down to point.
Lyon pulls his length back and bowls it around off, Haque goes deep inside the crease, controls the bounce well and pulls it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Tossed up ball on off, another forward defense offered by Haque.
Floated one on off, watchfully defended off the front foot by Mominul.
A shade short in length around off, Haque moves back inside the crease and punches it to covers.
Flighted off spinner outside off, Haque gets forward to cover the spin and allows it through.

While crossing over at the end of over, Steven Smith has some words of advice for Mehedi Hasan. After playing the last ball, Hasan mimed playing a pull and we could see Maxwell also saying something from behind the stumps after that.
Cummins steams in from around the wicket and serves a short ball around off, Mehedi shows good technique as he blocks it out safely.
Bouncer! The batsman does well to evade it.
FOUR! Precious runs for Bangladesh! The follow-up delivery by Cummins is very full and around middle and leg, Mehedi unfurls a beautiful on drive for a boundary.
Much better this time! Short in length around off, angling in, Hasan does well to drop his wrists and allows it through to the keeper.
Bouncer around leg, well over the head of the batsman. Hasan ducks. Waste of energy.

Nicely played! A short delivery served from around the wicket and Mominul eased himself into the pull shot. Didn't try to hit it hard and controlled it well. The fielder in the deep made the stop and they crossed for a single.
Leans forward to a full ball and defends it with soft hands.
A touch flatter and around off, Mehedi is on the back foot in defense.
A miscued sweep shot this time by Mominul. It gathers the top edge but falls in no man's land behind square leg. Another run taken.
Spinning back into the batsman from around off, Mehedi stays back and turns it through mid-wicket for a run.
Turns it off his pads to the leg side, finds the gap behind square leg and crosses.
A flighted off spinner around off, Hasan sweeps it across the line but fails to keep it down. Catch it is the shout but it goes wide of the backward square leg fielder. A single has been taken.
Back of a length delivery in the zone outside off, Mominul plays it from the back foot and taps it down towards backward point.
Switches to around the wicket for Mominul and bangs in a short ball. A little too high to bother the batsman of short stature. He ducks and Wade leaps to collect the ball.
Similar to the last delivery, not quite short but it's worked nicely behind square leg for a single. Gutsy batting from the young man.
Physio rushes out. Mehedi Hasan has hurt his right thumb and is bleeding. He is receiving some treatment. Magic spray doing its magic. It's his bowling finger and hopefully no damage is done.

Boom! Right on the grille of the helmet! A well-cooked bouncer by Cummins, sharp pace, Mehedi gets back to defend but misses. He takes a blow on his helmet and the protector comes off. It seems it took some part of the glove as well. He is in some pain.
A back of a length delivery on off, Hasan goes deep inside the crease, jumps and punches it through covers for a couple of runs.
Sliding down the leg side, Haque nudges it to fine leg for one.

Dropped by Maxwell! The edge was always coming given the way Haque was playing Lyon. Another tame push by him inside the line and the away spin plus bounce grabs the outside edge. It goes quickly to Maxwell at gully who reacts but it's too high. Brushes his shoulders and runs behind. Smith retrieves it from first slip. They take a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Lyon serves it short and outside off, Mominul slaps it through point and collects a couple of runs.
Make it three in a row. Mominul is not reading it well. Tries defending from the crease but misses as it curves away.
Once again it turns a shade from around off, Haque attempts to defend from the crease but is beaten.
Tossed up ball around off, slight away spin there, Mominul pushes at it and misses.
Nathan Lyon to bowl...
More of the short stuff from Cummins. This time he angles it into the batsman. Hasan is taken by surprise and the pace is too quick for him and he sways away at the last moment.
Short and angling into the body. Hasan stands tall and drops it on the leg side.
Pitched outside off, Hasan gets behind the line and blocks it.
Mehedi Hasan strides out to bat.

OUT! Pat Cummins has struck! Good captaincy from Steven Smith. The change has provided the breakthrough for him and it's of the opposition skipper, Mushfiqur Rahim. Back of a length delivery around off, holds its line after pitching. Rahim pokes at it and that proves to be his undoing. The ball catches the outside edge and goes straight into the gloves of Matthew Wade. This is a big, big wicket for Australia. It seems the break in play disturbed Mushfiqur's concentration. THE LEAD IS NOW 57!
Angling into the batsman, defended well on the leg side.
Back of a length delivery around off, gets big onto Rahim, who fends it off the splice. Extra bounce on offer straightaway for Cummins.
Pat Cummins is inserted back into the attack.

Time for a drinks break! The pitch is showing uneven bounce and it got the better of Sabbir Rahman. However, a partnership has started to build between skipper Rahim and Mominul Haque. Australia will look to break this stand and wrap things as quickly as possible. They will know that chasing a target in excess of 100 will be tricky on this surface.

Four Byes! Mominul is making the same mistake that Sabbir Rahman was doing. He too shapes up for the reverse sweep but the length is not right to play it. The ball spins down the leg side and Haque fails to connect it. Even Wade behind the stumps can't stop it and the ball runs away to the fence. Monimul has to be careful as they don't have many wickets left in hand and the lead is only 57 currently.
Spinning into the southpaw, Mominul gets across a touch and works it with the spin on the leg side.
Quicker through the air on middle and off, Haque covers the stumps and blocks it comfortably.
Full on middle, clipped towards mid-wicket for a single.
Served outside off, spins away a touch, dabbed towards point.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Shout for lbw! But, it seemed a lot high. Sliding into the southpaw, Mominul goes back to pull but misses and gets rapped on the thigh pad. The players appeal but it's turned down. Height is the question. The Hawk Eye shows that it would have been umpire's call, had Australia opted for the review.
A touch short this time, spins in. Rahim hangs back and pulls it behind square on the leg side. Doesn't connect it off the meat and hence only a single results.
Full outside off, pushed to mid off.
Quicker through the air, around off. Mushfiqur presents a solid front foot defence.
Full around off, spinning in, Rahim prods forward and turns it on the leg side. The man at mid-wicket, goes to his left to pick up the ball.
Flatter outside off, Rahim gets behind the line of the ball and defends it neatly.
Sliding into the pads, Haque covers the stumps and works it behind square on the leg side.

EXTRA BOUNCE AGAIN! Served short and wide outside off. Spins in a touch, Mominul goes back to cut but the extra bounce beats him. Wade does well to collect it. The batsmen need to be wary of the bounce, as we saw it in the last couple of overs that the ball is kicking off the surface.
Rahim gets down the track and milks down to long off for a single.
Fullish outside off, pushed with ease to covers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Short outside off, spinning in, Haque goes back and cuts it through point for a single. Lead is 50 now.
Served fuller around off, spinning in, Rahim shuffles across a touch and turns it on the leg side.
Full on middle and off, Rahim prods ahead and blocks it.
Arm ball outside off, bowled quicker. It bounces a touch extra as well. Haque punches it off the splice square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Once again Mominul goes back to punch but gets it off the outer half towards gully.
Quicker through the air outside off, it skids on. Mominul looks to punch it away but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Lyon drops a touch short, it spins in sharply with extra bounce. It gets big on Rahim, who mistimes his pull over mid-wicket for a single.
Slightly shorter around off, chopped towards backward point for a single.
Bowled quicker through the air. Lands it full on middle, dug out well.
Served outside off, spins away a shade, keeps low again. Rahim does well to adjust and taps it in the cover region.
Another arm ball, this time sliding into the batsman. Keeps a touch low as well. Haque gets across and works it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Flatter and a touch shorter outside off, Mominul gets across and punches it on the leg side.
Full and sliding into the batsman, clipped wide of mid on for a single.
Ashton Agar is back for a bowl.
Floated outside off, Haque lunges forward and lets the ball through to the keeper.
Flatter around off, Mominul shuffles across and defends it neatly.
Fuller around off, driven on the off side.
Again a short one from Lyon, Mominul camps back and defends it neatly.
Fuller in line of the stumps, the batsman lunges forward in defence.
Shorter around off, Haque stays in his crease and defends it.
Nathan Lyon is back from the other end.
Fuller outside off, driven towards long on for a single.
Spilled into the pads, swept towards deep square leg for a single.
Quicker around off, Rahim camps back and defends it solidly.
Sprayed down the leg side, helped towards fine leg for a single.
Shorter around middle and off, Haque gets behind it to defend.
FOUR! Floats this fuller outside off, Mominul waits for it and smashes it through the point region for a boundary.
Change of ends for Steve O'Keefe!
Floats it around middle and leg, Rahim tries to clip it on the leg side. Gets it towards covers off the leading edge.
Rahim prods forward and blocks it away.
Rahim manages to defend it towards point off the outer half.
Rahim stays in his crease to block it away.
Rahim stays in his crease and clips it on the leg side.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Ashton Agar is called back for a bowl.
FOUR! Shorter outside off, Haque guides it really late past the short third man region. The fielder gives it a chase but fails to stop the ball from going into the fence.
Mominul camps back and defends it.
Haque gets forward and presents the ball with the full face of his bat.
Mominul is done waiting as he plays the sweep through the square leg region for a couple.
Haque gets to the pitch of the ball and drives this towards covers.

Technically a dropped catch! Shorter around off, Mominul goes back and tries to cut. Gets an inside edge onto it and the ball hurries towards the keeper. Wade fails to react quickly and it goes behind off his pads. Too tough.
Fuller around middle and off, driven towards covers.
Rahim lunges forward and defends it.
Rahim gets behind the line of the delivery to defend it.
Sprayed down the leg side, Haque goes for the sweep. He gets it away from the inner half of the bat past the keeper. A single taken as the ball rolls towards short fine leg.
Fuller into the pads, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Shorter around off, Rahim clips it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Eased towards long on for a single.
Floated outside off, clipped towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Shorter around off, Rahim stays deep in his crease and defends it neatly.
Shorter around off, punched towards wide of covers for a single.
Sprayed into the pads, Mominul clips it fine down the leg side for a couple to get off the mark.
Shorter around off, Haque camps back and defends it watchfully.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Rahim prods forward and defends it solidly.
A bit quicker outside off, Rahim camps back and defends it neatly.
Mushfiqur lunges forward and defends it neatly.
Floats it outside off, Rahim prods forward and defends it.
Short and spinning into the batsman, Rahim stays tall and defends it.
Mominul stays deep and blocks it neatly.
Haque lunges forward and blocks it away.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The batsman tries to defend as he gets it towards gully off the edge.
Mominul gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Mominul Haque finally walks out to bat. He usually plays at no. 3 or no. 4 but this is the first time he has come lower down the order.

OUT! Sabbir Rahman runs out of luck! Floated outside off, the ball stays low. Rahman dances down the track and tries to defend it. Is undone by the turn and the lack of bounce. The ball sneaks through to the keeper who picks it up and dislodges the bails in no time. The players appeal and the umpire goes upstairs to check it. Rahman is not waiting and is already walking. The replays confirm he was way outside the crease. The hosts have lost another vital wicket and this is Nathan Lyon's 20th wicket of the series. Bangladesh lead by 25 runs!
The umpire has refereed the stumping appeal upstairs. Sabbir Rahman knows he is short of his ground and has started to walk off.
Fuller in line of the stumps, defended neatly by the batsman.
Flatter around off, Rahim prods forward an defends it.
Eased towards long off for a single.
Rahim runs it down towards third man for a single.
Quicker around off, Rahim prods forward and defends it.
Tossed up outside off, Mushfiqur shoulders his arms to it.
Rahman stays in his crease and defends it on the leg side.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fuller outside off, driven towards mid off.

Stifled appeal turned down! Shorter delivery and spinning into the batsman, Rahim stays tall to defend as the ball kicks off the deck. Goes off something as Warner at leg slip dives forward to catch. The players appeal but the umpire is not interested. Replays show it was off the thigh pad.
Flatter outside off, Mushfiqur guides it towards the fielder at short third man.
Shorter and spinning into the batsman, Rahim stays deep in his crease and defends it.
Quicker around off, Sabbir defends it neatly.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Sabbir lunges forward and defends it neatly.
Rahman camps back and defends it.
Sprayed into the pads, clipped on the leg side for a single.
Outside off, Rahim shoulders his arms to it.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
50-run stand is up between Rahman and Rahim! The duo added 105 runs in the first innings and now once again they are stitching an useful partnership.

Four byes! Again tossed up around middle and off, spinning in. The ball stays low as Rahman again goes for the reverse sweep. Fails to make contact again and the ball goes through the keeper's legs for a boundary.

Floats this one around middle and off, spinning into the batsman. Rahman shuffles across and goes for the reverse sweep. Misses it completely as it goes through to the keeper. Wade collects the ball and waits for Sabbir to fall over but the batsman manages to keep his balance and stay in. The bails are whipped but to no avail.
Shorter and spinning into the batsman, Rahim clips it on the leg side for a single.
Floated outside off, Rahman prods forward and pushes it towards covers for a quick single.
Fuller around middle and leg, nudged towards backward square leg for a single.
Nathan Lyon to bowl from the other end.
Tossed up outside off, Sabbir shoulders his arms to it.
Spinning into the batsman, Rahman gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.

Gives it a bit of air and bowls this around leg, Sabbir Rahman dances down the track and goes for the heave. Gets an inside edge on it and the ball rolls past the keeper towards fine leg for a couple.
Quicker around off, Sabbir prods forward and defends it.
Tossed up wide outside off, Rahman shoulders his arms to it.
Shorter into the pads, clipped towards mid-wicket for a single.
The players are making their way out in the middle. Mushfiqur Rahim and Sabbir Rahman to continue with the bat while Steve O'Keefe will begin proceedings with the ball for Australia. Here we go...
... Day 4, Session 2 ...

After losing 5 quick wickets, the Bangladeshi side would have needed someone to step up and Rahim responded really well there. He has managed to stitch in a partnership with Sabbir Rahman which is worth 40 runs at the moment. They will be hoping that these two continue and build on the lead. The Aussies will have only one intention, pick quick wickets after Lunch to put the game in bed. The next session could decide the contest. Join us in a while.

What a session of Test cricket! Bangladesh started off well by finishing off the Australian innings quickly. They then stepped out to bat but soon found themselves in trouble. The hosts kept on losing wickets as Nathan Lyon once again was in his elements. None of the top five batsmen could withstand the trickery of the pitch as it kept deteriorating every passing ball.

Floats the last ball before lunch in line of the stumps, Rahman clips it uppishly but the ball falls just short of the fielder at short mid-wicket. That could have really changed the course of the game altogether. THAT'S LUNCH ON DAY 4!
Rahman stays in his crease and defends it.
Outside off, spinning sharply. Rahman shoulders his arms to it. After the ball, Rahim has some discussion with umpire Gould. Not sure about what but things seem to have got tensed here.
Rahman reaches to the pitch of the ball and defends it.

Another tossed up outside off, Rahman again fails to make contact with the reverse sweep as he gets hit on his pads. The ball goes past the keeper as the players appeal. Replays show that it was off the gloves.
Floats this one outside off, Rahman goes for the reverse sweep but fails to make contact.
Bowled into the pads, nudged towards backward square leg for a single.
Fires this outside off, Sabbir shoulders his arms to it.
Shorter around off, Rahman gets forward and blocks it away.
Drifting into the pads, Rahim shuffles across and clips it towards fine leg for a single. The players appeal but replays show that there was a pretty evident inside edge.
Rahim camps back and defends it.
Fuller around off, Rahim lunges forward and defends it.
Sabbir Rahman changes his gloves. Also, makes use of this break to fill his thirst.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Just short! Floated around off, Sabbir Rahman lunges forward in defence. Gets an inside edge on it and the ball falls just short of Handscomb at short leg.
Fuller around off, Rahman goes for the reverse sweep. Gets a bottom edge on it and the ball bounces over the slip fielder. The batsmen run a couple.
Eased towards long on for a single.
Mushfiqur camps back and defends it off the back foot.
Spinning in from outside off, Rahim shuffles across and tries to defend it off the front foot. Gets an inside edge, it deflects off the pads and falls short of Handscomb at short leg.
Full outside off, Sabbir lunges forward to defend.
A bit shorter around off, Rahman gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Rahman lunges forward and defends it.
Short and into the pads, clipped through square leg for a single.
Rahim stays deep in his crease and defends it.
Tossed up outside off, kicks off the deck. Rahman stays deep in his crease and tries to defend it. But the cherry hits the splice and lobs towards the vacant silly point region.
Spinning in from around off, Sabbir this time goes for the sweep. Gets it off the gloves and the ball goes over the leg slip fielder for a couple.
Tossed up outside off, Rahman again goes for the reverse sweep. Mistimes it this time as the ball goes on a bounce towards the fielder at backward point.
Clipped through backward square leg for a single.
Spinning into the batsman, Rahim defends it on the leg side.
Shorter around off, Rahim camps back and defends it towards point.
Tossed up outside off, Rahman lets it through to the keeper.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Quicker outside off, Rahman shoulders his arms to it.
Sabbir gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
FOUR! Good shot! Bangladesh have taken a 2-run lead now! Bowls this around middle and leg, Rahman goes for the sweep again. Makes good contact as the ball races away to the fence at deep square leg.
Floated around off, Rahman dances down the track looks to play it across the line but gets a leading edge towards mid off.
Rahim clips it on the leg side, finds leg gully.
Spinning down the leg side, Rahim tries to defend it. Gets surprised by the extra bounce but still manages to drop it short of the fielder at leg slip.
Shorter outside off, Rahim shuffles across and defends it neatly.
Rahim lunges forward and defends it neatly.
Tossed up outside off, Rahman dances down the track, reaches the pitch of the ball and drives it towards wide mid off for a single.

Shout for lbw! Turned down again. Quicker outside off, Rahman goes for the sweep but fails to make contact this time. The players start appealing as the ball hits the pads but the umpire stays put as Sabbir was hit outside the line.
FOUR! Attacking shot! Tosses this one fuller outside off, Rahim goes for the sweep this time. Gets it over the square leg region and in the gap for a boundary.
Shorter around off, Rahim uses his crease well to defend it.
Rahim gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it neatly.
Rahman stays in his crease and nudges it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up around off, Sabbir prods forward and defends it.
Shorter around middle and off, clipped towards wide mid on for a single.
Short outside off, punched towards cover-point for a single.
Rahim gets forward and blocks it away.
Floated outside off, Rahman dances down the track and lofts it over mid on for a single.
Shorter around off, cut towards point for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Sabbir prods forward and tries to defend it on the leg side. Finds the gap and picks up a single.
FOUR! Floated outside off, Rahman goes for the reverse sweep this time. Plays it through the gully region for a boundary. Good shot, this.

Just away! Slower through the air outside off, straightens a touch. Rahim prods ahead to defend, gets an outside edge and the ball flies on the off side. Handscomb at silly point reacts quickly but the ball falls away from him.
Rahim leans ahead and presents a solid front foot defence.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Sliding down leg, tickled towards fine leg for a single.

NOT OUT! The impact was the issue! Slower through the air outside off, Rahman comes forward and then takes a stride ahead to defend. The ball again raps him on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire stays put. Even after the bowler withdraws from the appeal, Wade and Smith from behind the stumps keep appealing, almost begging it to be given out. But, the umpire stays with his decision. Australia opt for the review. The replays confirm that the ball hit the front pad first and that Rahman was playing a shot. The Hawk Eye shows that the impact was well outside off. This time, umpire Llong gets it right. DECISION STAYS!
Shout for an lbw. Nothing from the umpire. A delayed call by Steven Smith to take the DRS. Impact although seems to be outside off. Let's see...

NOT OUT! Big inside edge! Arm ball by O'Keefe, sliding into the batsman. Rahman looks to defend but seems to have missed as the ball hits his pads. The players appeal their hearts out and the umpire raises the dreaded finger. Sabbir opts for the review straightaway. The replays shows that there was an inside edge, confirmed by the Ultra Edge. The decision has to be OVERTURNED!
Sabbir Rahman has been adjudged lbw. He has taken the review though. Looks close...
Steve O'Keefe has a change of ends too.
Arm ball around off, skids in with the angle, Rahim hangs back and defends with a straight bat.
Quicker one outside off, defended with soft hands on the off side.
Extra bounce on offer! Served wide outside off, rises onto the batsman, Rahim adjusts well and guides it square of the wicket on the off side.
Loopy delivery outside off, spinning in, Rahim takes a good stride forward and blocks with bat and pad close.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.

Muted appeal for lbw! Tossed up outside off, spinning in, Rahim goes for the reverse sweep. Misses again and the ball hits him on the pads. The players appeal but it's turned down. The impact was well outside off.
Change of ends for Nathan Lyon!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Drifting into the pads, tucked through backward square leg for a run.
Shortish around off, punched on the off side for a single.

FOUR BYES! Wade had no chance there. Full down the leg side, Rahman looks to tickle it but misses. The ball doesn't bounce at all. It goes through Wade's legs and to the fence behind. Bangladesh won't mind how the runs come now!
Sliding into the pads, Rahim goes back and punches it through mid-wicket for a single.
Full around off, pushed to covers off the front foot.
Ashton Agar is finally introduced into the attack.
Mushfiqur Rahim is getting some attention on his right index finger. Doesn't seem anything serious as he gets it taped.
Lands it outside off, Rahman looks to play at it but then aborts.
Full around off, Rahim swivels and sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Slanting into the batsman, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Arm ball, sliding in, Rahim gets across and turns it through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Tucked with the spin behind square on the leg side for a single.
Dabbed to point from within the crease.
Served outside off, spinning in, Rahim leans ahead to defend but the ball takes the inside edge and rolls on the leg side.
Tossed up around off, spinning in with extra bounce. Rahim shapes up to reverse sweep. Misses and the ball brushes his body before going to leg slip.
Rahim dances down to defend but gets it off the toe end of the bat, into the deck and towards the keeper.
Tossed up around off, spinning in, flicked with the turn on the leg side.
Rahman stays back and defends it neatly off the back foot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Sabbir Rahman walks out next.

OUT! This time Hossain is not so lucky! Tossed up around off, spins away a touch. Nasir leans ahead and pushes at the ball. Gets an outside edge off the higher part of the bat. It flies past Wade's gloves and Smith at first slip doesn't take his eyes off the ball. He keeps his concentration on and then pouches it with ease. Half the Bangladeshi side is back in the hut. First wicket of the match for Steve O'Keefe and the Aussies are well on top. The hosts still trail by 29 runs.
Almost chopped on! Quicker delivery, sliding in. Hossain goes back to guide but gets a bottom edge. The ball bounces in front of the stumps and goes over it. He is a lucky man.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
FOUR! Poor delivery, punished! Short and sliding into the batsman, Hossain camps back and hammers his pull over mid-wicket for a boundary.

Shout for lbw! Quicker through the air outside off, spins in sharply. Rahim dances down the track and looks to hoick it with the turn. Misses and gets rapped on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire stays put.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Spinning into the batsman, flicked with the spin towards mid-wicket.
Mushfiqur Rahim is the new man in. The skipper has to play out of his skin to pull his team out of troubled waters.

OUT! 10-fer for Nathan Lyon! This has been a superb performance from the offie. He becomes the highest wicket-taker for Australia in a single series of two matches. Served quicker through the air around middle and off, spins away a shade. Shakib looks to play with the spin but the ball goes off the outer half to Warner at gully. The opener is alert and takes a sharp reflex catch. The No. 1 all-rounder has to depart and the hosts are in a crisis now.
EDGED BUT AWAY! Darted in at 93 kph. Shakib leans ahead to defend with a straight bat. Gets an outside edge and it runs past Warner at gully. A brace is taken.
Slants it into the batsman, straightens a touch. Hasan has his eyes on the ball and defends it carefully.
Full on middle and leg, driven to mid on.
Straighter one around off, Hossain leans forward and blocks it solidly.
That spun a long way! Tossed up outside off, inviting Hossain into a drive. Nasir obliges but gets beaten by the sharp away turn.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Hossain covers the line of the ball and then defends.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Slower through the air around off, Shakib prods ahead to defend but the ball spins away. Keeps low this time as Wade crouches to pouch it.
This time Shakib manages to defend it off the middle off the back foot.
GRIP AND TURN! Lyon drags his length a touch back, landing it around off. Shakib goes back to defend but the ball spins away sharply with extra bounce. Al Hasan is surprised and gets beaten.
Driven neatly to mid off by leaning ahead.
Full around off, pushed off the front foot on the off side.
Shakib Al Hasan makes his way out to the middle.

Time for Drinks! Bangladesh have lost their top-order in the first hour of play and they still trail by 35 runs. It seems to be a really tough job for them to bat on this track which seems to be spitting venoms. Australia will be really happy with their bowlers are going about.

OUT! Another one goes down! Shorter delivery outside off, the ball stops onto the batsman a bit, Kayes stays in his crease and checks his shot at the last moment. Ends up pushing it uppishly. The ball goes straight to the fielder at covers. Maxwell holds onto it and Lyon gets his second. Imrul's struggle to adapt to the number 3 spot continues.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
A bit fuller around off, driven towards gully off the outer half.
Again sharp spin there! Floated outside off, Hossain gets forward to defend but fails to get his bat on it.
Outside off, spinning away. Hossain defends it well there.
That spun a mile! Wide outside off, spinning away. Moves away a lot as Wade still manages to catch it.
Shorter around off, punched back to the bowler.
Tossed up around off, spinning away. Kayes goes for the drive but gets beaten completely by the away spin.
Kayes lunges forward and blocks it away.
Floated outside off, defended neatly by the batsman.
Shorter outside off, pushed towards covers.
Nasir camps back and pushes it towards short third man for a single to get off the mark.
Floated around middle and leg, Hossain prods forward in defence. Gets an inside edge onto his pads and the ball wobbles just wide of the fielder at short leg.
Imrul lunges forward and blocks it away.
FOUR! Short delivery around middle and off, Kayes camps back and pulls it powerfully through the square leg region for a boundary.
Shorter around off, Imrul stays deep in his crease and defends it.
Imrul lunges forward and defends it.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Kayes gets forward and defends it.

Nasir Hossain is the next man in. He has a promotion in the batting order, mainly to provide the right-left combination in the middle. Bangladesh have plenty of left-handers in their batting rank and at times it becomes too predictable.

OUT! Lyon sways his wand of magic! Floats this one around off, Tamim dances down the track and tries to block it away. But gets beaten by the extra spin and bounce. Iqbal is way down the track as Wade collects the ball near his chest before dislodging the bails. Excellent glovework. The players appeal and the umpire goes upstairs to check. Replays show that Tamim was well outside the crease and was no way close to coming back. A big, big wicket for the visitors as Iqbal can be really dangerous. Bangladesh trail by 40 runs.
Tamim has been outfoxed here! The umpire has gone upstairs to check for it it.
Tossed up outside off, Tamim reaches to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Short delivery around middle and leg, spins away a touch. Kayes stands tall and tries to defend it. Gets surprised by the extra bounce but he still manages to push it past the slip region for a single.
Fuller into the stumps, driven towards covers.
Shorter outside off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Iqbal stays deep in his crease and defends it on the off side.
Kayes gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it towards long on for a single.
Floated outside off, Iqbal lunges forward and tries to clip it through. Gets an inside edge through the leg gully region for a single.
Short and drifting into the pads, Tamim just blocks it with his pads.
Fuller around leg, clipped towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Freebies! Short and wide outside off, Tamim Iqbal enjoys the length and cashes in on it by punching it through the cover-point region for a boundary.
Fuller around off, Imrul lunges forward and blocks it away.
Again short outside off, pushed towards point.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
A bit shorter outside off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Kayes stays in his crease and defends it neatly towards point.
Fuller around off, Kayes lunges forward to defend.
Nathan Lyon to have a change of ends.
Floated outside off, Tamim shuffles across and pads it away. A stifled appeal is denied by the umpire.
Kayes clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Again around the same area, Iqbal adjusts well and punches it towards long on for a single.
Shorter around middle and off, pushed back to the bowler.
Spinning in from outside off, Iqbal defends it neatly.
Short delivery outside off, Tamim stays deep and defends it.
Steve O'Keefe has been handed the ball. Can he land the Australians a quick wicket?
Short delivery around off, Imrul sways away from the line of the ball.
Fuller around off, driven towards mid off.

Why isn't a short leg in place? Cummins can bowl that length day in and day out and trouble any batsman in the world with his pace but Smith seems to have different plans. Short delivery into the batsman, Kayes stands tall and somehow fends it away. Had there been a short leg, he would have pouched it.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Sprayed down the leg side, Kayes lets it through to the keeper.
FOUR! Streaky! Good length delivery outside off, Kayes tries to defend it. Gets it off the outside edge, past the slip cordon for a boundary.
Around middle and leg, Iqbal clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Tamim lunges forward and blocks it away.
Fuller around off, Tamim gets forward and drives it towards covers.
Iqbal stays in his crease and defends it.
FOUR! Terrific Tamim! Floated around middle and leg, Iqbal dances down the track, reaches the pitch of the ball and lofts that over the cover region for a boundary.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

FOUR! Streaky runs! Back of a length delivery outside off, Kayes stays in his crease and tries to defend it. Gets an outside edge on it and the ball flies through the gap between the keeper and the first slip fielder for a boundary. Wade didn't even react, probably got wrong footed there.
Kayes stays tall in his crease and defends it.
Another full delivery in line of the stumps, Kayes gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Fuller delivery around middle and leg, driven towards the fielder at mid on.
Short delivery into the batsman, Kayes stays tall in his crease and defends it. Gets it off the outer half towards the slip cordon.
Bangs this short around off, Kayes tries to fend it away. The ball whizzes past the outside edge and goes through to the keeper.
A bit quicker around middle and off, Tamim gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Tamim lunges forward and defends it.
Tossed up outside off, TI shoulders his arms to it.
Fuller in line of the stumps, Tamim blocks it away.
Outside off, Iqbal lunges forward and defends it towards the fielder at point.
Floats this one around off, Tamim Iqbal prods forward and defends it.
Good length delivery outside off, Kayes stays in his crease and defends it neatly.
Imrul Kayes walks out to the middle.

OUT! Cummins strikes! Continues from around the wicket and bowls it on a length around off. It heads towards the batsman with the angle and Sarkar gets squared up in his attempt to defend from the back foot. It takes the outside edge and flies towards Matt Renshaw at first slip who catches it with safe hands. Australia have drawn first blood and Sarkar's misery with the bat continues. Bangladesh trail by 61 runs!
Good length delivery angling into the batsman, the ball stays low. SS still manages to defend it somehow. Variable bounce could trouble the batsman.
Short delivery into the batsman, Sarkar sways away from the line of the ball.
Again angling into the batsman, Sarkar gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Angling into the batsman from a length outside off, Sarkar stays deep in his crease and defends it.
Sprayed into the pads, clipped towards fine leg for a single.
Outside off, Sarkar lets it through to the keeper.
Floated outside off, Sarkar lunges forward and defends it.
Sprayed down the leg side, clipped through square leg for a single.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Drifting into the batsman, Iqbal lunges forward and defends it.
Meanwhile, we have the slightest of drizzles. Hope that it goes away soon.
Another short delivery into the batsman, Sarkar sways away from the line of the ball. Cummins gives Soumya some words of advice.
FOUR! Good shot! Length delivery outside off, Sarkar slaps it through the gap between point and backward point for a boundary.
Length delivery around off, pushed towards covers for a single. Tamim Iqbal gets off the mark with that one.
Another short delivery outside off, this time Tamim fancies the cut but fails to make contact. Just goes past the bat towards the keeper.
That's dug in really short! Iqbal ducks underneath it and Wade stretches to catch that ball.
Fuller delivery around off, Tamim gets behind it and blocks it away.
Turn and bounce this time! Tossed up outside off, spinning away. Sarkar lets it through this time.
Sarkar stays deep in his crease and defends it.
Fuller around off, driven towards the fielder at covers.
A bit shorter this time, Sarkar camps back and punches it on the off side.
Tossed up outside off, Sarkar shoulders his arms to it.
FOUR! Floats this one outside off, Soumya Sarkar goes after it as he sees width on offer. Gets it off the outer half through the backward point region for a boundary. First runs for Bangladesh.
Nathan Lyon will start with the new ball from the other end for Australia.
Good length delivery outside off, Iqbal gets beaten by the away swing as he tries to defend it.
Good length delivery outside off, moves away off the deck. Tamim gets forward to defend but gets beaten by the away movement.
Back of a length delivery around off, TI stands tall and defends it.
Fuller delivery outside off, Tamim gets forward and defends it on the off side.
Good length delivery around off, nipping away. Iqbal tries to push it on the off side but gets beaten by the away movement.
Starts with a fuller delivery around middle and off, Iqbal lunges forward and clips it straight towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
